notes.title: Lost at Birth - Chapter 9 (CE)
notes.content:
https://i.ibb.co/8X5RMRQ/lab-banner-steam-update.jpg
Here's Chapter 9 (CE) of Lost at Birth.
Now available on Steam. I hope you like it.

Changelog:
-Chapter 9 (Part 2) added.
-Animations: 2 animations added.
-New music added.
- Part 1 proofread and dialogue improvement.
-Gallery added.
-Tons of bug fixing.

NOTE: This is not a regular update but the part missing from Chapter 9.
There's not much content in this, if you want something substantial please wait for chapter 10.

NOTE: To compensate for this, the next update will be releasing next month.

notes.title: Lost at Birth - Chapter 8
notes.content:
https://i.ibb.co/Xbr5SNz/lab-banner-steam.jpg
Here's Chapter 8 of Lost at Birth.

Now available on Steam.

I hope you like it.

Changelog:

- Chapter 8 added

- Animations: 5 animations added

- Auto save system at end of content added

- Skip credits option added

Misc:
Fixed the bug where animations wouldn't play for some players even when the option is ON. (Changed variable from define to default)

If the animations still don't work for you even after this update, I added a temporary fix:
- Added a file to force the animations to play.

To make it work just drag and drop the file named "anim_force_play" to the /game folder.
https://i.ibb.co/9sj33Ns/LAB-anim-fix-tutorial.jpg
